faqs.question: Can candidates from other states apply for UP Police Constable recruitment?
faqs.answer: Yes, Indian citizens from any state or union territory can apply for UP Police Constable recruitment. However, non-UP residents will be treated under the Unreserved (General) category and will not be eligible for caste or age relaxations.

faqs.question: Is there negative marking in the UP Police Constable written exam?
faqs.answer: Yes. There is a negative marking of 0.50 marks for each incorrect answer in the OMR-based written examination. Each question carries 2 marks.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for UP Police Constable?
faqs.answer: The candidate must have passed 10+2 (Intermediate) examination from any recognized Board of Secondary Education in India.

faqs.question: What is the physical running requirement for male and female candidates?

faqs.question: What is the monthly in-hand salary of a UP Police Constable?
